scope: New adjacent themes from the Aug 24 deep-research pass. Research-only overlay for the Developing Themes page.

newThemes.name: AI Power Reliability: Backup + Power Quality
newThemes.status: Active developing theme / direct hyperscaler validation
newThemes.summary: The next power bottleneck is increasingly reliability around constrained grids: backup generation, UPS, batteries, switchgear, voltage control, harmonic filtering and maintenance. Generac's large data-centre backlog shows this has moved from theory to contracted hyperscaler demand.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: Large AI facilities cannot tolerate grid interruptions or delayed interconnection. The value pool therefore expands beyond generation and transmission into equipment that keeps power stable and available at the site.

mainNews.title: Generac data-centre backlog validates backup-power bottleneck
mainNews.implication: Backup generation is becoming a direct AI-infrastructure order stream rather than a peripheral adjacency.

newThemes.name: AI Memory + Advanced Packaging Bottleneck
newThemes.summary: HBM and memory costs are beginning to affect full AI-server economics, while qualified packaging, thermo-compression bonding, hybrid bonding and test capacity are becoming scarce system-level infrastructure.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: Reported AI-server price inflation tied to memory plus customer-funded packaging capacity shows that the constraint is not only DRAM supply. Integrating HBM with accelerators requires specialised equipment, packaging and test capacity that can gate system delivery.

mainNews.title: AI-server prices reportedly face memory-driven increases
mainNews.implication: Memory scarcity is becoming a system-level capex constraint rather than a semiconductor sub-cycle alone.

mainNews.title: Amkor partnerships validate advanced-packaging capacity as strategic infrastructure
mainNews.implication: Customer funding and long-term partnerships reduce demand uncertainty around new packaging capacity.

newThemes.name: AI + Physical-AI Networking
newThemes.summary: The networking layer between data centres, factories, robots and industrial control is becoming a differentiated picks-and-shovels opportunity. Belden combines data-centre connectivity with industrial Ethernet and automation exposure at a less extreme valuation than many optical leaders.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: AI infrastructure increasingly needs more than GPUs: resilient high-speed connectivity, industrial networking and edge links are required as compute moves into factories, distribution centres and physical automation.

mainNews.title: Belden record orders show AI and physical-AI networking demand entering the order book
mainNews.implication: Networking can be an investable physical-AI bottleneck without relying on a single chip or optical component.

newThemes.name: Sanctions Enforcement + Maritime Intelligence
newThemes.status: Active research theme / no clean pure play yet
newThemes.summary: Tougher Iran sanctions and vessel restrictions raise the value of AIS tracking, beneficial-ownership data, sanctions screening, ship-to-ship-transfer detection, trade-finance controls and maritime-risk intelligence.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: As sanctions shift from named entities toward networks of vessels, counterparties, insurers and intermediaries, compliance becomes a larger operating cost and a more valuable data layer. The theme is real, but current listed pure plays are too diluted to force an equity idea.

mainNews.title: US prepares tougher Iran sanctions as Hormuz restrictions persist
mainNews.implication: More complex enforcement increases demand for maritime and trade-compliance intelligence.

newThemes.name: Marine War-Risk Insurance
newThemes.status: Active physical chokepoint / no clean target-market equity
newThemes.summary: Insurance capacity can become as important as vessel capacity when tankers must cross war-risk zones. Rising premiums, exclusions or refused cover can restrict physical energy flows even when cargo and ships are available.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: Governments are discussing state-backed insurance support as commercial war-risk capacity tightens. This makes insurers, reinsurers and brokers part of the physical energy-security chain, although the cleanest exposures currently sit outside the target US/HK/Malaysia universe.

newThemes.name: SPR Replenishment + US Energy Security
newThemes.summary: With the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve near late-1982 levels, the post-crisis policy trade may eventually shift from emergency drawdown toward rebuilding the buffer. That can support domestic barrels, storage, pipelines and Gulf Coast logistics after the immediate war premium fades.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: A smaller emergency stockpile raises the strategic value of domestic supply and logistics. The investment opportunity is more durable if it comes from refill and infrastructure demand rather than assuming permanently extreme crude prices.

mainNews.title: US Strategic Petroleum Reserve remains near a late-1982 level
mainNews.implication: A prolonged disruption leaves less federal buffer and increases the future value of replenishment and domestic logistics.

newThemes.name: North American Electrical Localisation
newThemes.summary: US-Canada tariff volatility adds another incentive to localise electrical equipment and industrial supply chains inside the final market. Existing qualified capacity may gain value faster than debt-funded greenfield projects.
newThemes.whyDeveloping: Repeated tariff shocks can change sourcing decisions for electrical equipment, metals and industrial components even when the direct headline trade value is modest. The preferred exposure is a profitable supplier with installed capacity and qualification rather than a speculative reshoring buildout.

mainNews.title: US-Canada trade talks break down as new tariffs are imposed
mainNews.implication: Policy volatility can increase the strategic value of already-installed domestic electrical and industrial capacity.
